H1_dynamic_strength.rule: REJECT iff all four 95% CIs of pooled DL(B1-arm, B0) include 0 or lie entirely > 0

H2_home_court.rule: REJECT iff for both K, CI of (K,100)vs(K,0) includes 0 or favors HCA=0

H3_rest_schedule.rule: REJECT iff CI of B2-a vs B2-b includes 0 or favors B2-b

language_law: calibration language only; no PnL/betting/edge vocabulary
